high_level_description: The image is an aerial view of Ferrari World, a theme park located on Yas Island in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The structure is prominently featured in the center of the image, with its distinctive circular design and red and white color scheme. The surrounding area appears to be under construction or development, with various cranes and construction equipment visible. The text overlay on the image reads: "RISING FROM THE SAND." Below this, it states, "It took only three years to build this marvel, in a terrain covered with sand where the temperatures rise above 40°C.
